answer: The wander counter is kept in canyon and cedar reveals each reset. An farming party therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 29 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 29 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1970 identities would post 3515 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
